map.输入地形图比例尺（如 1:1000）与图上长度或实地距离，自动换算对应的实际距离: Enter the topographic map scale (such as 1:1000) and either a map length or a ground distance, and the tool converts to the matching ground distance or map length, for quick swapping of map and ground dimensions during reading and setting out.
map.图上长 = 实地长 / 比例尺分母: Map length = ground length / scale denominator
map.地形图比例尺与图上/实际距离的相互换算: Conversion between topographic map scale and map distance / ground distance
map.图上距 ↔ 实地距按比例尺互转。: Map distance and ground distance convert into each other through the map scale.
map.图纸与实地放样。: Setting out on site from a drawing.
map.：1:1000 图上 0.5m → 实地=0.5×1000=500m；实地 2k: On a 1:1000 map, 0.5 m on the map gives 0.5×1000 = 500 m on the ground; a ground distance of 2 km is 2000/5000 = 0.4 m on a 1:5000 map.
map.：图距=实距/分母、实距=图距×分母，单位统一到 m 再算。: Map distance = ground distance / denominator, ground distance = map distance × denominator; convert the units to m first.
map.纵坡 = 高差 / 平距: Longitudinal slope = elevation difference / horizontal distance
map.由横基尺长度与夹角求距离: Distance from a horizontal baseline and the included angles
map.由半径与转角求切线长: Tangent length from the radius and the angle
map.1:n 即图上 1 单位=实地 n 单位，n 越大图越小越概略。: In 1:n, 1 unit on the map equals n units on the ground; the larger n, the smaller and more generalized the map.
map.面积怎么换？: How do I convert the area?
map.面积比=比例尺平方，1:1000 图上 1cm²=实地 100 m²。: Area scales with the square of the scale: on a 1:1000 map, 1 cm² on the map is 100 m² on the ground.
